problem.observation: The native entry unit contains only quoted includes, while the v1 builder declared only sha256(mini_entity.c) as source identity and random seed. Included source bytes were not transitively bound by that field.

unusual_experiment.name: included-source identity collision falsifier
unusual_experiment.intervention: Compile one tiny translation unit including part.inc, mutate only part.inc, recompile while retaining the same entry-file SHA as -frandom-seed.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: Different included source can share the same declared entry SHA while producing different executable bytes.

mechanism: recursively hash every reachable project-local quoted include
canonicalize relative path + sha256 + size into source_closure
derive source_identity_sha256 from the canonical closure
reject dynamic or macro include targets
reject quoted includes escaping the native source root

cases: transitive local include mutation changes closure identity while entry SHA remains unchanged
local include escaping source root fails closed
